An Ordinance

[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-12(Law)/73-II,
dated 25-7-2001.---The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Civil
Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force as
once.

Insertion of new section in Act IX of 1974

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-12(Law)/73-II,
dated 25-7-2001.---The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Insertion of new section in
Act IX of 1974.----In the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (IX of
1974), after section 11; the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:,--
"11-A. Absorption of
Civil Servants rendered surplus.-- Notwithstanding anything contained in
"this Act, the rules, agreement, contract or the teens and conditions of
service, a civil servant, who is rendered surplus as a result of reorganization
or abolition of a department, office or abolition of post in pursuance of any
Government decision may be appointed to a post, carrying basic scale equal to,
the post held by him before such appointment, if he possesses the
qualifications and fulfils other conditions applicable to that post;
Provided that where no equivalent
post is available he may be offered a lower post in such manner, and subject to
such conditions, as may be prescribed and where such civet servant is appointed
to a lower post the pay being drawn by him in the higher post immediately
preceding his appointment to lower post shall remain protected."
